adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, the helper uses `safeParse` but then immediately `throw new Error(...)` when `!refreshTokenResponse.success`, so parse failures will throw rather than be returned as a `{ success: false, ... }` result. Several call sites still treat the return value like a normal `safeParse` result (e.g. Office365 spreads `tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data`; Salesforce checks `if (!accessTokenParsed.success)`), making their failure-handling logic effectively unreachable. The claim about there being no tests for this edge case cannot be verified from the diff alone (no test changes are shown), but the behavioral/API mismatch is diff-grounded.
